g.text: Histogram gradient boosting · Noisy / delayed sightings
Each point uses its checkpoint-specific model; this is not max-over-checkpoints AUC. Dashed horizontal: chance (0.5).
Bands: pointwise 95% paired source-group bootstrap intervals; 64 groups per cohort. History is a bounded 71-feature representation.
